correctness.rationale: For both source recurrences, the first-round target-cover accumulator equals \(M^2\) exactly when the off-target support hits that cover set. Therefore hitting every target-cover set is necessary and sufficient for one-round contamination, and the next target-only gradient gives \(M^2+\delta^2\). The matrix and tensor slice covers have exact transversal number \(2\).

value.rationale: The cover is SM3's central memory-saving design object. The exact transversal number measures how much unrelated support is sufficient to destroy coordinatewise adaptivity in one round. Its value \(2\) for standard matrix and tensor covers, independent of rank, provides a concrete cover-design diagnostic and makes the protection-versus-memory role of singleton sets explicit.
